scripts:
create path (sling:Folder) /apps
create path (sling:Folder) /libs
register namespace (crx) http://www.day.com/crx/1.0

register nodetypes
<<===
<'cq'='http://www.day.com/jcr/cq/1.0'>
<'dam'='http://www.day.com/dam/1.0'>
<'granite'='http://www.adobe.com/jcr/granite/1.0'>
<'nt'='http://www.jcp.org/jcr/nt/1.0'>
[cq:Taggable] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[cq:ReplicationStatus] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[cq:LiveRelationship] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[cq:LiveSync] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[cq:LiveSyncCancelled] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[cq:PropertyLiveSyncCancelled] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[dam:Metadata] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[dam:color] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[dam:Thumbnails] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[dam:cfVariationNode] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
[granite:Ranking] mixin
  - * (undefined) multiple
  - * (undefined)
  + * (nt:base) = nt:unstructured
===>>

create service user studio-wcm-service
set ACL for studio-wcm-service
    allow jcr:read on /apps
    allow jcr:read on /libs
end

create service user clientlibs-service
set ACL for clientlibs-service
    allow jcr:read on /apps
    allow jcr:read on /libs
end

create service user sling-scripting
set ACL for sling-scripting
    allow jcr:read on /apps
    allow jcr:read on /libs
end
